text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, the long-awaited Arima<n>Kinen! And out of
all the Umamusume<n>chosen to participate, the one
making<n>headlines is...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Beast, Grass Wonder! Everyone<n>is on the edge
of their seats, eagerly<n>awaiting her clash with her
biggest<n>rival, Special Week!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Calm. And very much so. You<n>could say
I've found my comfort<n>zone.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the moment<n>when the
starting gate opens.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm both grateful and honored to<n>share the
racecourse with such<n>worthy competitors.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But most importantly, I will press<n>forward.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win... This is my race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let's give this race our all!

You two look excited. Don't get too<n>down on
yourselves when I turn out<n>the winner.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: For me, losin' here ain't an option.<n>Comprenden?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Here it is: the fanfare of the Arima<n>Kinen!
